submitted_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2008-01-01' AND g.name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10;
validated_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line AS il JOIN public.invoice AS i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN public.track AS t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN public.genre AS g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2007-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2008-01-01' AS DATE) AND g.name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10
